# OLYMPUS v0.0.8, "Pairs": the build sheet

Written 2026-11-07 for the round's four implementers (react, specials, scene, face) and the lead who integrates: the contract between roles building in parallel without talking. Where it is silent the docs decide (DESIGN.md and the user's rules, then TECH §1.3 on implementation, then COMBAT §25 and the sections); my own choices are marked (my call) and every disagreement settled here is in §8.

**The release.** ROADMAP §4.2's 0.0.7b row, shipped as v0.0.8: `test-pairs`, "Pairs" (`?play=test-pairs&tier=recruit|private|sgt|raider|tierone`, the Tests menu's "Pairs"; COMBAT §25.10.3). The 25 m bay of X3 (v0.0.5) gains a 7 m and a 10 m line painted on a new pad and a turning target in front of each of its six frames. The R-7 and three magazines (10, 10 and 2 rounds); a generated coach with a shot timer. Five strings: (1) one target turns at 7 m while you wait at low ready out of stop motion; (2) two turn together at 7 m; (3) three turn at 10 m, one a no-shoot; (4) the armoured silhouette at 10 m; (5) two at 10 m on the two-round magazine: it runs dry, RELOAD; then a lull: Top up. A sheet picker (boot recruit, private, sergeant, Raider, tier one) and "Again as …" on the same seed. Scenes never write a career.

**What the user must feel.** The turn comes at 1:1; the brackets close round the target over the marine's own take-in and the keys are not yours until he has taken it in; the pause arrives with "Contact · 0.55 s." and the stamp, and the recruit's 0.65 s against the tier one's 0.05 s reads as the marine's skill, never as lag. The shot rows are a real choice, priced and with their odds before you press, each round its own roll and its own hole. The steel's ring and "He's still up" are a moment. The reload in the lull is the gun-handler's craft. "Again as tier one" on the same seed shows the gulf. Quick to replay (about 4 real minutes), never a dead end.

**The user's rules hold over every section**: the bay, its lines and its turners authored; which turner turns when, which is the no-shoot, which the armoured, the gaps and the words procedural from the seed on named streams; the coach generated; 16 px/m chibi (`?ppm=24` a test density only); every picture and sound made by code; nothing pops; no fast travel; graphics over words, no overlapping UI; AZERTY labels on physical codes. COMBAT §25.16's defaults hold: the taps become rows and the real-time Fire-again is retired (9); the tier one plays in the test scenes (10); the untrained's feet stop during the take-in, the pre-armed's carry on (11); floors of 0.25 s for a true surprise and 0.15 s alert, the tier one's one tick only where expected (12); Argyre later (13). The range lessons (DESIGN.md, 2026-11-07): never a dead end, one magazine a string (this course's exception written in, §8 item 19), reach and see what it holds, kinds of rounds. **test-handling (100/100/100 ★) and test-range must not get worse**: their courses by their bots to the tick, their scores and words (§3.3). Actions over `LIVE_MAX_MS` 10 s go behind the brief splash (none in this scene is that long).

**Rules of the round**: only your own files (§1); a change in a file you do not own goes in your report as the exact edit; no commits, branches, tags, pushes, `release.sh` or `promote.sh`; never `.play/`, :8200, :8201, `../longhaul`, `../tradecraft` (read only; their ports 8090, 8100, 8101, 8112, 8123 never) or `docs/research/`; scratch under `/private/tmp/claude-501/olympus-build/r8/<role>/`. **Ports**: react 8231, specials 8232, scene 8233, face 8234; the integrator 8236; reviews 8237 to 8239; `OLYMPUS_TEST_PORT` for `tests/browser.mjs`; kill every server. Tests: `node tests/run.mjs '<file> ›'`, `QUICK=1 QUICK_LIMIT_S=300 node tests/run.mjs` for everything quick; CPU ceilings × `machine().k`, a ceiling that fails under load rerun alone first. Look at what you build (`node tools/shot.mjs`, 16 px/m). Docs and CHANGELOG.md are the lead's: return CHANGELOG bullets and doc items (file, section, exact change).

**Interfaces first.** Each role first writes §2's exports as stubs with the shapes given, then fills them; test against your own stub of a dependency until it is real, and say so. **Merge order**: react, specials, scene, face; `QUICK=1 node tests/run.mjs` after each.

## 2. Interfaces

JavaScript signatures; `state` the saved state, `bus` the core bus, `pid` a person id, times integer game ms; positions in the area's frame (x east, z south, y up, metres); a face's coordinates in cm from its centre, x right and y down (v0.0.5's convention). Pure unless marked **w**. A target key on the bay is `'turner:<lane>'`.

### 2.1 react

**The take-in** (`react.js`; COMBAT §25.4.2; the only module that defines a reaction delay, checked):

```js
coreMs(wf) → ms                       // TAKEIN_FLOOR_MS + TAKEIN_SPAN_MS × (1 − min(wf, 100)/100) ^ TAKEIN_EXP; unrounded
ticks(ms) → ms                        // max(1, round(ms / TICK_MS)) × TICK_MS: 50 the least
severalK(n) → 1 + SEVERAL_K × log2(max(1, n))       lightK(le) → 1 + LIGHT_K × (1 − min(1, le / LE_FULL))
bodyK(awarenessMods) → min(BODY_K_MAX, 1 + BODY_K × −Σ v)        goMs(wf) → max(GO_MIN_MS, GO_BASE_MS − wf)
takeInOf({ wf, expect, grade = 'pass', n = 1, whoK = 1, stanceK = 1, lightK = 1, bodyK = 1, behindK = 1, band = 0 }) →
  { ms, rawMs, parts: [{ why: 'Warfighting 15', ms: 536 } | { why: 'not where your muzzle was', k: 2 } | { why: 'under fire', ms: 200 }] }
  // ticks(max(EXPECT[expect].floorMs, coreMs × EXPECT[expect].k × NOTICE_K[grade] × whoK × severalK(n) × stanceK × lightK × bodyK × behindK) + SUPP_MS × band);
  // parts list only the terms ≠ 1 (and Warfighting's core always), in the log's words (§4)
expectOf(state, pid, target, ms) → 'sector' | 'area' | 'alert' | 'surprise'
  // sector: the target's bearing within SECTOR_HALF_DEG of the muzzle's yaw (carry.js muzzleOf) with the rifle in the hands
  // (low ready, high ready, aimed: §8 item 5); area: clearing (none this round); alert: a course of fire's string or
  // threatKnown; surprise: the rest
takeInMs(state, pid, contact) → { ms, expect, grade, roll, parts, n, whoK }
  // contact: { id, targets: [{ key, x, z, rangeM, face }], seenMs }; the notice check (SKILLS check(), Awareness against
  // NOTICE_DC0 + round(rangeM / 10), +NOTICE_BEHIND behind, NOTICE_SECTOR in a held sector) on
  // stream(seed, 'combat:notice', pid, contact.id, seenMs); the slowest expectation of the targets; whoK the worst (WHO_K
  // for a face 'unknown', else 1: §8 item 6); stanceK 1, band 0 this round (§8 item 8)
takeInWords(ms) → '0.55'   // two decimals: the one formatter of the quantity (stamp, plaque, line, paper, log, card)
```

**The turners** (`turners.js`; the record is the scene's, written through these):

```js
TURN_MS 300
turnerKey(lane) → 'turner:<lane>'
turnersOf(state) → state.armoury.range?.turners ?? []
facingOf(T, ms) → 0..1           // edge-on 0, facing 1: sin(π/2 × k), k over TURN_MS from T.turnAtMs; from T.awayAtMs back to 0,
                                 // starting from the facing it had (min(turning, 1 − sin(π/2 × k_away)) taken as a closed form)
turnTo(T, atMs) → T;  turnAway(T, atMs) → T        // w; the record's times, whole ticks (the scene calls them)
turnerTargets(state, ms) → [{ key, kind: 'turner', lane, x, y, z, face, holds, facingK, down: bool }]   // down: T.stoppedAtMs ≠ null
```

**The contact** (`contact.js`; COMBAT §25.4.1, §25.4.5, §25.4.6):

```js
contactLook(state, input, bus, ctx)    // w; fast 'look' (people domain), lived ticks only: each turner not in mind.contact.known whose
  // seenK = sightOf(state, me, { x, z }).vis × facingOf(T, ms) reaches SEEN on this tick opens the window (the 'contact' fact
  // 'seen') or joins the one open ('join': untilMs re-taken as the first seenMs + takeInMs with n and the worst whoK).
  // Only turners in the session are looked at (≤ 6); nothing written when there are none (a gunless game is untouched)
contactInput(state, input, bus, ctx)   // w; fast 'input' (people domain; runs while held): with a window open and clock ≥ untilMs,
  // and no live step (state.stop.mode 'live') still running: the pause: enterStop(state, bus, { via: 'contact', pick }) with pick
  // the window's target nearest the muzzle, the identification of each, mind.contact.last, the log entry (kind 'contact'), the
  // 'contact' fact 'pause', holdTime 'stop'. A live step running at untilMs: the pause at that step's end (§25.4.5)
refusesAct(state, action) → bool       // true while a window is open: every sim action (game.js act's gate, §2.6)
feetOf(state, input) → { mx, mz }      // while a window is open: the move vector held at its seenMs until seenMs + goMs(wf), then 0
                                       // (not pre-armed: the feet stop; pre-armed (pending.armed): the held vector all through; none this round)
pendingOf(state) → pending | null
contactNow(state, ms = state.clock.ms) → null | {
  pending: { id, ids, seenMs, untilMs, ms, k (0..1 of the window at ms), expect, n } | null,
  last: { id, ids, seenMs, atMs, ms, expect, n, grade, parts, ident: { [key]: Ident }, armour: { [key]: true }, words } | null }
  // words: "Taken in in 0.55 s: 0.54 (Warfighting 15) × 1 (your sector); Awareness 6 + 14 = 20 against 7, noticed."
identify(state, pid, key, { bonus = 0, atMs }) → { ident: Ident, armour: bool, roll }   // w (writes last.ident[key], last.armour[key])
  // Awareness against IDENT_DC0 + round(rangeM / IDENT_PER_M) (+IDENT_DARK in the dark), − bonus, on
  // stream(seed, 'combat:ident', pid, contactId, key, atMs). Passed: T.holds ('rifle' | 'pistol' | 'hands' | 'phone') and, on an
  // armoured face, armour; failed: 'unseen'. Never a weapon that is not there (COMBAT §25.4.6)
contactRows(state, pid, ms) → [Row]    // at or after a pause, the bracketed target in last.ids and up:
  // 'contact:hold' "Hold him" (subs ['aim'?, 'hold']: the aim if not on him, then the held aim to +4; no shot)
  // 'contact:challenge' "Challenge · 1.2 s" (where last.ident[pick] is 'unseen', 'hands' or 'phone'); each Row with lead: true
  // when last.ident[pick] is 'hands' or 'phone' (an identified no-shoot: they lead the panel, COMBAT §25.4.6)
runContactSub(state, bus, d, id, atMs) → { ms, text }    // w; 'contact:challenge' at its start: "Show me your hands!" (say, kind 'speech', you)
endContactSub(state, bus, d, id)                        // w; at its end: identify(…, { bonus: CHALLENGE_BONUS }); the line says what you now see
lullOf(state, pid, ms) → bool          // no window open, no threat facing un-stopped, and LULL_MS since the latest of your last
                                       // shot, the last pause and the last turner gone edge-on (turnerTargets, facingK < SEEN)
```

`Ident` is `'rifle' | 'pistol' | 'hands' | 'phone' | 'unseen'`. **The accessors** (`people/mind.js`; TECH §6.1): `contactOf(state) → state.mind.contact ?? null`; `noteContact(state, patch)` (w: creates `state.mind.contact` on first use only, merges the patch); `noteMind(state, part, rec)`, `mindOf(state, part)`. Nothing else writes `state.mind.contact`.

**The sheets** (`templates.js`; SKILLS §11.1; COMBAT §25.3.2, §25.10.4): `TIERS` gains `recruit`, `recon`, `raider`, `tierone` from SKILLS §11.1's rows (`rollSheet` on them for NPCs later; no existing draw moves). `TEST_SHEETS` (§4) `{ [tier]: { label, wf, values: { marksmanship, weapons, awareness, fitness, … }, rung } }`; `testSheet(tier) → sheet` (`{ cls: 'soldier', os: wf, skills: { k: [base, bg] }, drills: { room: { rung }, passage: { rung } } }`, bases solved so `value()` gives §4's values exactly, bg only past `BASE_MAX`); `RUNG_OF_TIER` (§4); `rungOf(state, pid, family = 'room') → 0..4` (`sheet.drills?.[family]?.rung`, else `RUNG_OF_TIER[tierOfRank(rank)]`).

### 2.2 specials

**The rows** (`specials.js`; COMBAT §25.6.1 to §25.6.3). A Row is the step panel's shape (`{ id, kind, label, ms, rushMs, carefulMs, odds, routine, off, subs, cmd, skill, target, warn? }`) plus:

```js
Row += { kind: 'shot', rounds: [{ part: 'torso' | 'head', odds, climb, follow, climbK }], parts: [{ k: 'aim' | 'press' | 'round' | 'shift', ms, part? }], gate: { skill: 'marksmanship', v } | null, first: bool }
ROWS = { pair, hammer, triple, failure, head }        // ids 'shot:pair' … 'shot:head'; gates, ranges, rounds: §4
shotRows(state, pid, ms) → [Row]
  // the bracketed target a turner (or a person) facing (facingK ≥ SEEN), the gun believed able (in hand, a round believed
  // chambered), in the row's range. Below rung 2 a row is struck 'off safe first' on safe and 'aim first' when not aimed at the
  // target; from rung 2 its aim part does both. Below the gate: struck
  // with the gate's words ("Marksmanship 12"), listed after the offered; out of range or not relevant: absent.
  // Order: Failure drill first where the target has taken torso hits and stands (T.hits) or armour was seen (last.armour);
  // To the head first after "He's still up" (still up: torso hits this contact, not down); else Pair, Hammer, Triple, Failure, head
rowPlan(state, pid, rowId, target, { tempo = 'normal', atMs }) → { ms, parts, rounds }
  // parts at their formula times (cumulative from the row's start; the sub-steps of the step):
  //   aim    (rung ≥ 2 and not aimed at the target) aimMsOf(target), the selector to semi at its start at no time (§8 item 3)
  //   press  TRIGGER_S × 1000
  //   round  resolved at its start (the round leaves); its ms the interval to the next part:
  //          pair: the single pull fireMs (the second sight picture); hammer, triple: TAP_SPLIT_S × paceOf(WH); the last: recoverMs
  //   shift  HEAD_SHIFT_S × paceOf(WH): the failure drill's assessment and the shift; To the head's whole start
  // rushed: aim and splits × TEMPO.rushed.timeK, each round −3; careful: the hold to +4 before the press
assessDown(state, key, atMs) → bool    // the failure drill's assessment: the target down after the pair (T.stoppedAtMs ≤ atMs)
runRound(state, bus, d, i, atMs) → { ms, shot }   // w; one 'round' sub-step: resolveShot({ part, follow, climbK, atMs, row }), the scene's
                                                  // recordShot; the failure drill's third not fired (cut, no round) on assessDown
reloadRows(state, pid, ms) → [Row]     // the built macros by purpose (ids unchanged, labels and order new, COMBAT §25.6.5):
  // 'macro:reload:speed' "RELOAD" (first when the bolt is believed locked on empty), 'macro:reload:tactical' "Top up" (first in a
  // lull, contact.js lullOf, with the magazine believed at half or less), 'macro:reload:retain' "RELOAD, keep the empty";
  // when the session names a magazine (R.wantMag), Top up's queue reaches for its pouch ('reach@pN') and says so
  // ("Top up: the two-round magazine, chest pouch 3"); never done unasked
```

**The shot on a turner** (`shot.js`, `paper.js`; WEAPONS §7, §8.5):

```js
resolveShot(state, bus, { …v0.0.7, part = 'torso', climbK = 1, atMs = state.clock.ms, row = null })   // atMs: the round's formula time,
  // the record's and the mods' (the held aim at atMs), so a split reads true on the paper (§8 item 11)
modsOf(…, { follow, climbK }) → the climb −round(BURST_K × follow × recoil × climbOf(MRK) × ANCHOR.climb × SUPPORT × climbK)
dcOf({ model, rangeM, part })          // as built: a turner is a man-target, its DC by PART_DC (torso 0, head +6), no paper term
// a turner at facingK < SEEN, or down and turned away: the round passes it into the berm (hole null, 'past the target')
shot += { part, zone: 'A' | 'C' | 'head' | null, ring: bool, through: bool, row: { id, n, i } | null }   // hole.at on the man-target face
PAPERS.man = { word: 'the man-target', kind: 'man', sizeCm: [46, 76], zones: { A: [16, 28], torso: [46, 56], head: { r: 8, at: [0, −30] } } }
manHole(face, part, roll, shotId, seed) → { at: [xCm, yCm] | null, zone, word }
  // torso: margin ≥ A_MARGIN (SKILLS good) the A zone, a pass the C zone; head: a pass the head; a fail null (into the berm); the
  // place in its zone by hash (as card25's holeOf), the same every time
steelOf(state, shot, T) → { ring: bool, through: bool, down: bool }   // an armoured face: a torso round meets PLATE_MM of steelArmour
  // (penetrate.js throughMaterial on stream('pen', seed, shotId)): stopped rings, through holes it, neither puts it down; a head
  // round at A_MARGIN or better knocks the head plate (down), a pass rings
```

**The step list** (`shooting.js`): `stepsOf` at a pause (`state.stop` entered `via: 'contact'`, `contactNow().last`): the contact's rows that lead, then `shotRows`, then Fire, Aim or Hold, then the contact's other rows, then `reloadRows` in place of the reload macros, the rest as built. Off a turner the panel is v0.0.7's but for the reloads' labels and order. `runSub` dispatches `'press'`, `'round'`, `'shift'` (specials.js) and `'contact:*'` (contact.js); `endSub` calls `endContactSub`. `targetsOf` lists `turnerTargets` on the bay with a pairs session (kind `'turner'`, name "the target, lane 3"). `enterStop(…, { via: 'contact', pick })`. **`tap()` is retired** (COMBAT §25.6.4): Fire during a fire step is 'busy'; `tapsOf`, `TAP_SKILL`, `climbOf` stay (the rows' gates). **While a window is open no step's end holds time** (endStep sets phase 'choose' without `holdTime`; COMBAT §25.4.5).

### 2.3 scene

**The ground** (`src/data/places/range.js`; authored, the same in every career):

```js
PAIRS = { turnerX: 1124.0, lines: { 7: { x: 1117.0 }, 10: { x: 1114.0 } }, pad: [1112.6, 281.2, 1118.6, 299.8],
  face: { wM: 0.46, hM: 0.76, centreY: 1.35 }, stand: { w: 0.5, d: 0.3, h: 1.75 },
  lanes: [{ lane, z, turner: { x: 1124.0, z, fixture: 'f:kd:turner-<n>' },
            points: { 7: { fp, box, coach }, 10: { fp, box, coach } } }] }   // fp { x: line.x, z }; box and coach as the bay's (fp.x − 1.4 to + 2.2, fp.z ± 1.0; coach fp.x − 0.9, fp.z − 1.4)
RANGE_PIECES += kdTurner × 6 (block 'see'), kdPaint × 2 ('7 M', '10 M' across the pad, block null), the pad path 's:kd:pairs'
```

**The course** (`courses.js`): `COURSES.pairs` (§4) and `SEQ_PAIRS`, each command `{ id, ready, say: [≥ 2], string?, line? }`: brief (always) · load (magIn) · ready (pairsReady) · [standby (stringDone, string k) · stop (pairsReady)] for strings 0 and 1 at 7 m · move10 (pairsReady on the 10 m point) · [standby · stop] for strings 2 and 3 · short (shortReady) · standby (string 4) · lull (toppedUp) · clear (shown) · end. Readinesses (`pairsReady` in pairs.js): **pairsReady** still, out of stop motion, the rifle at low ready, Condition 1 on safe, the finger off, in the current line's box (or `R.dry` and on safe); **stringDone** `R.str.done ≠ null`; **shortReady** pairsReady with `R.mags.short` in the rifle (or the move-on); **toppedUp** pairsReady with the magazine in believed above half, or a Top up seated since the lull began, or nothing fuller to top up with; `NEEDS_ROUNDS` gains `pairsReady`. `PAIRS_COACH`: the coach's words (≥ 2 phrasings each): the brief, standby, out-of-it, the paper said, still up, no-shoot hit, time, dry, short, lull.

**The scene** (`pairs.js`; on the course engine of `handling.js`, as test-range's kd course is):

```js
PAIRS_SCENE = { site: 'melas', area: KD_RANGE.area, course: 'pairs' }
testPairs(state, { at = null, setup = null, tier = 'private' } = {})   // w; the fill: the barracks drawn, the clock at the scene's hour,
  // the player on lane L's 7 m point (drawLane(seed, 'pairs'), 2 to 5) facing downrange, utilities, the start body, the sheet
  // testSheet(tier) written (the scene's player only), the 'range-pairs' issue (the R-7 slung front; the 10, 10, 2 magazines in
  // pouches 1, 2, 3), the coach generated ('melas:kd-coach') at your left shoulder, R.roId = R.coachId (§8 item 20), six turners
  // edge-on, then startRange(course 'pairs')
drawStrings(seed, lane) → [{ k, line, keys, faces: { [key]: 'threat' | 'noshoot' | 'armoured' }, holds: { [key]: Hold }, gapMs }]
  // every string's draw from the seed alone (never the sheet: "Again as" turns the same targets at the same gaps):
  // stream(seed, 'pairs:pick', k), stream(seed, 'pairs:gap', k, attempt), the holds by hash; weights in §4
pairsReady(state, def, ctx) → bool | null      // the readinesses above (handling.js lineReady asks it first on the pairs course)
pairsOnCmd(state, bus, def, i)                 // w; standby: the string's record, the turn armed (turnAtMs = now + gapMs) if you are
  // out of stop motion; stop: R.hot false, the turners still facing turned away; move10, short (R.wantMag), lull, clear
pairsActors(state, input, bus)                 // w; arms 'actors' layer, lived: the armed turn disarmed if you enter stop motion before
  // it ("Out of it. Wait for the turn.", once a string), re-armed with the next attempt's gap when you are out; at turnAtMs each
  // string turner turnTo(…), the 'turner' fact 'turn', R.hot; the string's end checked when you are still (below)
pairsShot(state, bus, shot)                    // w; handling.js recordShot's pairs branch: the issue's count, T.hits, the string's
  // shots, the hit sensor (a threat stopped at STOP_TORSO torso hits or STOP_HEAD head hit, an armoured at its head plate: T.stoppedAtMs,
  // turnAway after SENSOR_MS), the steel's ring ('fx' 'spark'), the no-shoot hit (fault 'noshoot')
pairsSecond(state, bus, ctx) → bool            // handling.js rangeSecond's pairs branch: STRING_MAX_MS, the dry check, the lull's start
stringEnd(state, bus, why)                     // w; R.str.done = 'stopped' | 'noshoot' | 'time' | 'dry' | 'declared' (on safe after a round):
  // taken only when you are still (no step running: a row is never cut by it); R.hot false; the paper (the 'range' fact 'paper',
  // the coach says it); every turner of the string turned away
paperOf(str) → { takeInMs, pauseToFirstMs, splitsMs: [ms], zones: { A, C, head, miss, noshoot }, text }
paperText(paper) → 'TURN TO PAUSE 0.55 · PAUSE TO FIRST 1.45 · SPLITS 0.40 · 2 A'   // the one helper: the coach, the paper, the card
  // TURN TO PAUSE = the take-in (seenMs to the pause: §8 item 2); PAUSE TO FIRST = the first round's atMs − the pause; SPLITS each
  // gap between rounds (two decimals, space-separated); zones in the order A, C, HEAD, MISS, NO-SHOOT HIT, zeros left out
pairsNow(state, ms) → { sheet, line, string, hot, cmd, str: { k, keys, done, paper } | null, strs: [Str], turners: TurnerView[],
  reloads, lull, rounds: { issued, fired, held }, card, summary }
  // card: { turn: [{ k, expect, n, takeInMs }], shots: { rounds, A, C, head, miss, noshoot, rows: { [rowId]: n } }, gun: { reload: { kind, ms } | null,
  //   topUp: { ms } | null, short: bool, rounds } }; summary the end card's: "Private · 5 strings · take-in 0.55 to 1.25 s · 13 A, 1 C, 2 head ·
  //   no-shoot untouched · RELOAD 2.53 s · topped up"
againAs(state, tier) → { scenario: 'test-pairs', seed, tier }   // what the end card's "Again as …" starts (main.js newGame)
```

`SCENES['test-pairs']` (scenes.js): `{ id: 'test-pairs', title: 'Pairs', scenario: 'test-pairs', hour: 11.0, goal: "Five strings at 7 and 10 m on the coach's timer. Wait out of it at low ready; when a target turns, take it in, then your shots. Threats only.", aspects: [['turn', 'the turn: the take-in, its time, the brackets and the stamp'], ['shots', 'the shots: the rows, their price, odds and holes'], ['gun', 'the gun: RELOAD when dry, Top up in the lull']], body: {}, outfit: 'utilities', course: 'pairs', endOn: { fact: 'range', phase: ['clear', 'stopped'] } }`; the Tests menu lists it after test-range.

`rangeNow` returns `pairsNow`'s summary on the pairs course, so the end card reads it as test-handling's and test-range's. The end is `range` phase `'clear'` (or `'stopped'`), as test-handling's.

**The instinct** (`instinct/pairs.js`, scene; SKILLS §14; COMBAT §25.8.3's lines that fit a range; ≥ 4 phrasings each; **all silent while a window is open**; T never a shot):

| Id | Tone | When | T does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `pairs-ready` | warn | a standby to come, not pairsReady | the next of: on safe, low ready, aim at your lane's turner (the muzzle downrange), X out ("Low ready, on safe. Out of it: X. Let it come.") |
| `pairs-wait` | calm | the turn armed | nothing ("Wait for it.") |
| `pairs-contact` | urgent | at the pause, nothing fired at it | below rung 2: off safe, then aim at the bracketed; from rung 2: aim; never the shot ("Rifle, your lane. Off safe. Aim. Then press.") |
| `pairs-noshoot` | warn | the bracketed identified 'hands' or 'phone' | Hold him ("Hands. No weapon. Don't.") |
| `pairs-unknown` | warn | the bracketed 'unseen' | Challenge ("Can't see his hands. Challenge him.") |
| `pairs-still-up` | urgent | torso hits on it this contact and it stands | aim at it if not aimed ("He's still up. Head.") |
| `pairs-reload` | warn | the bolt believed locked on empty, rounds left | RELOAD ("Empty. Reload.") |
| `pairs-topup` | note | lullOf, the magazine believed at half or less, a fuller one at hand | Top up ("Lull. Top up.") |
| `pairs-short` | warn | the short command, the short magazine not in | Top up with it ("Top up with the short one.") |
| `pairs-reset` | warn | the string done, you in stop motion | on safe, then X ("Done. Safe. Out of it.") |

The line's lead at a pause, until the first step chosen after it, is `"Contact · " + takeInWords(ms) + " s."` in place of `STOP_LEAD` (instinct.js).

### 2.4 What the face reads

`contactNow` (the window's k for the brackets; `last` for the stamp, the plaque's lead and its strip, the hover's parts, the log), `stepsOf` (the rows: `kind 'shot'` with `rounds`, `parts`, `gate`, `first`; `contact:*` with `lead`; the reloads' labels), `plaqueOf` on a turner target with `part` ("HEAD 75% · 7 M"), `pairsNow` (the paper per string, the card, the summary, the sheet), `rangeLook(state, ms).pairs` (below), `TEST_SHEETS` (the picker's labels and numbers), `againAs`, the facts of §2.5. **Truth never leaks**: the brackets show where a target is, never what (no colour by face kind); the identification's words only after the pause.

```js
rangeLook(state, ms).pairs = null | { line, turners: [{ key, lane, x, z, y, facingK, face, holds, holes: [{ xCm, yCm, zone, ring, atMs }],
  down, plateAtMs }], lines: [{ x, label }] }   // look.js (scene): the stage's only door, as v0.0.7's kd
```

The **brackets** (main.js over the picture, plaque.js pixels): on the sighting tick, hollow amber corner brackets at `BRACKET_START_K` 3 times the target's box, closing linearly to 1× over `contactNow().pending.k`; at the pause they snap to the pale pick bracket. The **stamp** over the figure at the pause, `takeInWords(ms) + ' S'` in the 3 × 5 alphabet, amber from 0.50 s and pale below, for `STAMP_S` 2.5 s of real time. The **plaque's lead** "CONTACT · TAKEN IN 0.55 S" with a strip ticked every 0.1 s and filled to the take-in. **The paper** (hud/timer.js): the coach's shot timer after each string, `paperText`, placed by layout.js clear of every HUD rectangle.

### 2.5 Facts (`src/core/facts.js`, the scene role writes every line; CONTRACTS §11)

| Fact | Payload | Owner |
|---|---|---|
| `contact` (new) | `{ phase: 'seen' \| 'join' \| 'pause' \| 'ident', id, who, ids, seenMs, untilMs, ms, expect, n, grade, parts, ident: { [key]: Ident } \| null, armour: { [key]: true } \| null, atMs }` | COMBAT |
| `turner` (new) | `{ key, lane, phase: 'turn' \| 'away', face, atMs, toMs, why: 'standby' \| 'hit' \| 'string' }` | WEAPONS |
| `shot` (widened) | `+ part, zone: 'A' \| 'C' \| 'head' \| null, ring, through, row: { id, n, i } \| null` | WEAPONS |
| `range` (widened) | phases `+ 'standby' \| 'turn' \| 'paper' \| 'lull' \| 'short'`; `+ string, paper: { takeInMs, pauseToFirstMs, splitsMs, zones, text }` | WEAPONS |
| `fx` (widened) | kinds `+ 'spark'` (a round on steel: x, y, z, atMs, dir, size) | WEAPONS |
| `stop-mode` (widened) | `via + 'contact'`, `+ contact: { id, ms } \| null` | WEAPONS |
| `step` (widened) | actions `+ 'press' \| 'round' \| 'shift' \| 'contact:hold' \| 'contact:challenge'` | WEAPONS |
| `say` | the pairs coach speaks his commands as `'speech'` (no PA) | PEOPLE |

### 2.6 The shared files, exactly

- **`src/sim/game.js`** (scene): `SCENARIOS` gains `'test-pairs': testPairs`, `SCENARIO_SITES` its site; `newGame({ …, tier = null })` passes `{ at, setup, tier }` to the fill; in `act()`, first line: `if (refusesAct(state, action)) { stats.refused = (stats.refused ?? 0) + 1; return false; }` (contact.js); the header's line.
- **`src/sim/people/domain.js`** (react): `fast` gains `look: contactLook` and `input: contactInput`.
- **`src/sim/places/move.js`** (react): playerStep's `const mx = sgn(input?.mx), mz = sgn(input?.mz);` reads `feetOf(state, input)`.
- **`src/sim/arms/domain.js`** (scene): `actors: (s, i, b, c) => { kdActors(s, i, b, c); pairsActors(s, i, b); }`; `idFields` gain `'armoury.range.mags{}': 'i'`, `'armoury.range.wantMag': 'i'`.
- **`handling.js`** (scene): on `R.course === 'pairs'` only: `seqOf` gives `SEQ_PAIRS`; `lineReady` asks `pairsReady` first; `onRangeCmd` says commands as `'speech'` and calls `pairsOnCmd`; `rangeSecond` calls `pairsSecond`; `recordShot` hands to `pairsShot`; `afterStep` calls the string's end check; `rangeLine` gives the current line's box and `lane: undefined` (every lane's turner is yours: no 'lane' rule); `magSeated` draws no 'onemag' fault (`COURSES.pairs.oneMag: false`); `rangeNow` returns `pairsNow`'s summary.
- **`tests/syntax.test.mjs`** (react): `REACT_HOME 'src/sim/combat/react.js'`: a top-level name whose words include "take" and "in", or "react" with "ms", is defined nowhere else in src.
- **`src/sim/skills/instinct.js`** (scene): `RULES` gains `PAIRS_RULES` after the range's; the lead at a pause (§2.3).
- **`src/core/debug.js`** (face): `readParams` gains `tier` (`TIERS_URL` recruit, private, cpl, sgt, raider, tierone; else null: the scene's private).

### 3.1 The fields

- **`state.mind.contact`** (PEOPLE's key, through `mind.js` only): `{ n, known: { [key]: seenMs }, pending, last }`; created on the first contact, absent otherwise (a gunless game and test-handling never have it). `pending = { id, ids, seenMs, untilMs, expect, n, grade, roll, parts, rangeM, whoK, armed: false, goMs, mx, mz }`. Absolute `…Ms` only; additive.
- **The sheet**: `person.skills.drills = { room: { rung }, passage: { rung } }` on a test sheet only (absent: `RUNG_OF_TIER`).
- **The session** (`armoury.range` on the `pairs` course): v0.0.7's keys and `sheet, line, mags, wantMag, turners, str, strs, reloads, lull`. A turner `{ key, lane, x, z, y, face, holds, turnAtMs, awayAtMs, hits: [{ shotId, part, zone, ring, through }], stoppedAtMs }`; positions to 0.01 m, times whole ms.
- **The stop**: `stop.via` (`'contact'` when entered by a pause; written only then).
- **The shot record**: `part`, `zone`, `ring`, `through`, `row`, written only on a turner; its `atMs` the round's formula time (whole ms). So test-handling's and test-range's states, logs and saves stay byte for byte.

### 3.2 The upgrade (a v0.0.7 save loads)

**None is written** (v0.0.6's rule; BODY §2.5's "nothing is written on load"): every new field reads its default when absent: no `mind.contact` is no contact; no `drills` is the rank's rung; a v0.0.7 session has no `pairs` keys. `tests/saves/` gains two saves **made by v0.0.7's own code** (`git worktree add /private/tmp/claude-501/olympus-build/r8/react/base-v0.0.7 v0.0.7`): `v0.0.7-range-confirm.json.gz` (test-range `setup=confirm` after one shot) and `v0.0.7-handling-hot.json.gz` (test-handling `setup=hot` after two shots); `game-upgrade` loads every save, plays 600 ticks, and re-saves each byte for byte where nothing ran.

### 3.3 What a gunless game, test-handling and test-range change

- **A gunless game: nothing.** The detector looks only at a pairs session's turners; `mind.contact` is never created; GOLDEN_SANDBOX, GOLDEN_ROSTER and game-domains' digests unchanged. **GROUND_AREA's golden is re-set on purpose** (the pad, the lines, the six stands), said in CHANGELOG.
- **test-handling and test-range: nothing a player sees but the bay's six turner stands** (edge-on, no face hung, 1 m in front of the frames: face's shots show they cover no card nor the line) **and the reloads' labels by purpose** ("Top up" where the tactical RELOAD read "RELOAD"; RELOAD first on an empty bolt as before). Their courses by their bots on seeds 48213, 7 and 99 to the tick, their scores, the coach's words and their ids (`scene-handling`, `range-integration`, `range-nodead`, `scene-range`, `never-dead-end` green unchanged). Should a label change move a digest, specials says which and why.

## 5. Tests

Every test prints the numbers that matter, indented six spaces; names are sentences about the behaviour, with the user's words and date where a test pins their ask; assertions carry their evidence. A bound that is my estimate is a target: a role whose model disagrees prints its number, sets the bound to it with the reason, and says so in its report.

- **`react`**: prints §4's bay table and COMBAT §25.4.3's two tables from the code (every sheet × expectation × n; the factors: who, several 2 and 4, Relaxed, dim and dark, tired and exhausted, band 1 and 3, behind). Asserts: §4's table exactly; the private in a room 800, on a natural 1 1,200; the tier one 50 in his sector and a room, 150 alert, 250 surprised; no surprise under 250 nor alert under 150 for anyone; a natural 1 never costs more than ×1.5 where a 2 passes; monotonic in WF; every result a multiple of 50 and ≥ 50; `takeInWords(550) === '0.55'`.

## 8. Resolutions, and doc changes for the lead

Implementation by TECH §1.3, the rest by DESIGN.md and the user's rules; each (my call) unless a source is named.

1. **Four roles**: react (the take-in, the contact, the turners' facing, the sheets), specials (the rows, the reloads, the steel), scene (the place, the course, the strings, the paper, the instinct, the shared registrations), face (the picture, the panel, the paper, the cards, the sound). One owner per file (§1).
2. **"TURN TO PAUSE" is the take-in itself**, from the sighting (the face half round, `SEEN`) to the pause, so the stamp, the plaque, the line, the log, the paper and the card show one number (CLAUDE.md: one quantity, one number); the turner's first 0.1 s before the sighting is the motor's, not the marine's.
3. **On safe at the ready** (the Corps' rule: safe until you mean to fire): below rung 2 Off safe is its own step and the rows are struck "off safe first"; from rung 2 the row's aim takes the safe off at no time (the thumb during the mount), as COMBAT §25.6.1 puts the aim inside the row.
4. **The turners are authored stands 1 m in front of the frames** (x 1124.0, on each lane's axis, block 'see'), their faces hung by the scene and drawn from the session (none hung in test-handling and test-range); the lines at 7 and 10 m from the turners (x 1117.0, 1114.0) on a new pad; the frames and cards unchanged. COMBAT's "turning targets on the frames" read as on each frame's lane, so the 25 m card stays as scored.
5. **On a course of fire the muzzle at the ready is a held sector** (COMBAT §25.4.2's "an aim held on a point", widened to low and high ready, as the task's "within 20° of where the muzzle points" asks), refreshed by the coach's Standby; off it the string is `alert` (an exercise running). No `area` or `surprise` on the bay.
6. **Several at once**: the window's expectation is the slowest of those taken in, `severalK` by their number, `whoK` the worst; `whoK` is 1.5 only for a face whose hands are hidden ('unknown', none this round): a no-shoot 3 m off is not within 1 m (COMBAT §25.4.2).
7. **The untrained feet stop after `goMs`** with no braking distance until the stances are built (BODY §16.2's 0.21 m with test-shoothouse); nobody is pre-armed this round (no Watch, no bundle), the rule built and tested.
8. **`stanceK` is Combat's 1 and suppression 0** this round (no stances, nobody fires at you); every factor is built, tested and printed.
9. **The pause waits for a live step's end** (V, A, W out of the mode), and no stop-motion step's end holds time while a window is open (COMBAT §25.4.5); the turn only comes while you are out of stop motion, and entering the mode in the standby disarms it until you are out again with the next drawn gap (the coach: "Out of it. Wait for the turn.").
10. **The tap is retired** (§25.16, question 9's default): Fire during a fire step is 'busy'; `tapsOf`, `TAP_SKILL` and `climbOf` stay as the rows' gates; test-handling's and test-range's bots never tapped.
11. **A round's record takes its formula time** (`resolveShot`'s `atMs`), so the paper's splits read true below a tick (the tier one's hammer 0.11 s); the sub-steps still take the first tick at or after their boundary (TIME §4.3).
12. **A gated row shows struck with its gate** ("Marksmanship 12"), so the recruit sees what training buys; a row out of range or not relevant is absent (COMBAT §25.6.1's "offered only when relevant").
13. **Hammer and Triple within 7 m only** (C §25.6.1), so the 10 m line leaves Pair, the failure drill and To the head: the line teaches the rows.
14. **A paper threat "goes down" by the hit sensor**: two torso hits or one head hit turn it away after `SENSOR_MS`; the armoured falls only by its head plate at A_MARGIN or better, its torso rounds ringing on 10 mm of armour steel through `penetrate.js` (C §25.10.2: "steel falls when hit at good or better"); the failure drill's assessment reads the sensor.
15. **The A zone by margin** (good or better), C at a pass, the head by a pass; holes placed by hash within their zone (as `card25`'s `holeOf`).
16. **The d20 saturates on a still face at 7 and 10 m** (C §25.6.3's own figures): the shots aspect lives in time, the recruit's head, the plate's good and the rushed rows; the vital-zone +2 lever (C §25.15) waits for the user's score.
17. **Reloads by purpose label the built macros everywhere** (C §25.6.5: no id renamed): test-handling's panel says "Top up" for the tactical RELOAD, RELOAD still first on an empty bolt; its course to the tick.
18. **The short magazine is the coach's named one** (`R.wantMag`): before string 4 he says so and Top up's reach goes to its pouch; the rule's reach would never pick two rounds over ten.
19. **One magazine a string is waived on this course** (`oneMag: false`, written in): the dry RELOAD inside string 4 is the point (the user's lesson's exception).
20. **The coach runs the bay** (his commands as speech, `roId = coachId`), no RO on the tower for this scene; the coach says nothing while a window is open.
21. **A string ends when you are still**: all its threats down, a no-shoot hit, `STRING_MAX_MS` lived since the turn, dry with nothing to load, or on safe after a round (your "done"); a row is never cut by it, and its rounds past a target turned away go into the berm, no fault.
22. **The strings are drawn from the seed alone** (`pairs:pick`, `pairs:gap`), never the sheet, so "Again as …" turns the same targets at the same gaps; the dice of the notice and the identification are keyed by the contact and differ.
23. **The test sheets are fixed values**, the nearest a sheet can hold (the sergeant's MRK 19, the Raider's 31, the tier one's AWR 41: integer points × Warfighting's weight), written on the scene's player only, never a career; `cpl` by URL only (rung 2's first sheet).
24. **The beep is the turner's**: the coach's timer starts on the turn (its motor, then the clack as it faces); the stamp, not a sound, marks the pause (no words and no sound in the window: C §25.4.5).
25. **The act gate is game.js's one line** (every sim action refused while a window is open, in node and the page alike); the page refuses its own keys too but Space and Esc.
26. **The detector is the people domain's** (`look`, with the window's end in `input`), on the session's turners through `sightOf` until the player's sightings exist (0.0.10); `state.mind.contact` through `mind.js` only (TECH §6.1).
27. **The score line keeps ROADMAP §2.2's form exactly**; the sheet played is on the end card, not in the line.

**Doc changes for the lead**: CHANGELOG.md (each role's bullets; GROUND_AREA's golden re-set said); README's "Where it stands"; PLAYTESTS.md (§6); DESIGN.md's log (a 2026-11-07 entry for items 2 to 27, each my call, overrulable; COMBAT §25.16's defaults as played); ROADMAP §2.2 and §4.2 (the 0.0.7b row as built, shipped as v0.0.8); COMBAT §25.4 (the bay's table, items 2, 5 to 9), §25.6 (items 3, 10 to 17), §25.10.3 (the course, the strings, items 18 to 22); WEAPONS §5.3 and its reloads by purpose (about line 754: the labels, 17), §7 (the round's `atMs`, the man-target, 11, 15), §8.5 (the plate, 14), the follow-ups (about lines 976 and 1105: the tap retired, 10); SKILLS §11.1 (the new tiers, the test sheets, 23), §14 (the pairs rules); PEOPLE §8.8 (`mind.js`, `contactOf`, 26); PLACES §4.12 (the pad, the lines, the stands, 4); VIEWS §7.4 (the brackets, the stamp, the strip, the paper), §11 (the turner, the beep, the ring, 24); TECH §6.1 (`mind.contact`, the session's keys), §15.3 (`tier` built); CONTRACTS §9 (the fields of §3.1), §11 (§2.5), §13 (`takeInMs`, `contactNow`, `facingOf`, `rowPlan`, `paperText` as shared helpers).

## 9. Integration (the integrator's, 2026-11-07)

Merged in the sheet's order (react, specials, scene, face) from each role's worktree, then wired; every call below is the integrator's unless a role is named.

1. **No step's end holds time while a window is open** (§2.2, §8 item 9, specials' as built): react's contact test that expected a hold then its release now asserts that no tick inside the window is held; contact.js's release of a stray 'stop' hold stays as the guard.
2. **The pause's 'stop-mode' fact carries the contact** (`enterStop(…, { via: 'contact', pick, contact: { id, ms } })`, contact.js; §2.5).
3. **A key held in a window is not the marine's anywhere**: handling.js's range rules (moving) and shooting.js's stand-up out of the mode read contact.js `feetOf`, as move.js does.
4. **A re-armed turn is a fresh cue** (`R.cueAtMs`, pairs.js), so a long idle in the mode never drops your own lane to 'alert' (react's ask).
5. **The 'shot' fact registers `down`** (the head plate's verdict, specials' ask); test-pairs' setups `standby` and `standby:<k>` are in debug.js `SETUPS` (scene's ask).
6. **On the bay of turners a bolt believed locked on an empty puts RELOAD at the panel's head** (shooting.js stepsOf), over Fire struck and the aim; test-handling's and test-range's panels keep their order (§3.3).
7. **The page's test-range run in `browser` reaches the card again**: since v0.0.7's 10 s line the brass policing is an `ff` skip, and the test's loops stepped nothing while it ran (30,000 loops at tick 5,244). Node and the page now run an `ff` skip's ticks with no keys; the sim gains `ffTick(state)` (game.js), one fast-forward tick and its end check as the loop's frame runs them.
8. **A browser test for test-pairs' saves** (`browser`): the private and the tier one, saves mid-take-in, at a pause, between a row's rounds, in a Top up and in the dry RELOAD, each to the card on the straight run's digest, which is node's.
9. **Played by its keys** (§6): the boot recruit and, by its end card's "Again as Tier one", the tier one on seed 48213 at 1600 × 900; the private at 1024 × 768. Shots under `/private/tmp/claude-501/olympus-build/r8/integ/shots*/`.

**Left for the lead** (findings, not changed): the lull after string 4 rarely has anything to top up with (22 rounds: on seed 48213 every sheet reaches it with an empty magazine in and one round in a pouch), so the gun aspect's Top up comes between strings; the faces are drawn by kind (olive threat, pale no-shoot) while the identification may still say "can't see his hands"; from the private up every sheet papers the same hits on the same seed (the d20 saturates, §8 item 16, and the dice are keyed by the shot), so "Again as" differs in time only.

## 10. The review round's fixes (the fixer's, 2026-11-07)

After the code, runtime and design reviews and the integrator's list; every call below is the fixer's (my call) unless a review is named, and each is in CHANGELOG.md's Unreleased entry.

1. **The pause's guard** (main.js `PAUSE_GUARD_MS` 350, the cards' `CARD_GUARD_MS` 400 in kind): for 350 ms of real time from when the page first shows a pause no key acts but Space and Esc, and a key that went down in the window or the guard does nothing on its way up. The window's refusal (§8 item 25) stays.
2. **The picture draws belief** (pairs.js `seenFace`, the stage's door): every paper face is one board, `'paper'` (khaki), threat and no-shoot alike; what it holds only once this turn's take-in identified it (`last.ident`, a Challenge's answer too); `'unseen'` draws none; the steel stays steel (seen as steel). This narrows §2.4's "truth never leaks" from the brackets to the faces.
3. **"He's still up"** (specials.js `stillUp`, `STILL_UP_TORSO` 2; the coach's line in pairs.js): a torso round that rang on a plate, or two torso hits, and standing; one torso hit on paper is not it. pairs-still-up is listed before pairs-contact, which yields to it; one hit leaves "Again. Chest." (no act).
4. **The lull** (COURSES.pairs `lullMag` 10, `spoutTopUp`): opened at the last string's end (or the coach's "Lull"), when the coach hands over a fresh magazine of ten into a pouch with room, counted on the issue; Top up offered on this course with the magazine believed empty and a round up (drills.js).
